name: comp-550
title: File Type Upload List
blurb: File list with type icons and validation for mixed file types.
description: Multi-file upload showing icons based on file type (pdf, image, doc, etc). Supports mixed file types with individual removal.
use_when: Document collections, mixed media uploads, or visually distinct file type handling.
avoid_when: Single file type uploads; use specialized variants instead.
a11y: File type icons have implicit role via list structure. Remove buttons clearly labeled.
